customManagers.description: Track the vendored HetrixTools agent version (re-vendor on bump)

packageRules.description: Alpine apk pins are extracted by Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager (>= 44.97.1) as datasource `apk`; the :alpine preset supplies the grouping, rangeStrategy and automerge posture but stays release-line agnostic, so this URL is the ONE place the Alpine release line is written. Bump `branch=v3.24` when the base image crosses a release line (3.24 -> 3.25). `components=main,community` merges both indexes in a single lookup (registryStrategy 'merge'), so community packages need no separate registryUrls override.
